text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Chairman of the General Labour Confederation Elias Abu Rizk accused the government of interfering in union elections and arresting labour leaders in south Lebanon.
-One pro-Israeli South Lebanon Army militiaman killed and two were wounded by a pro-Iranian Hizbollah roadside bomb in south Lebanon.
-President Hrawi was quoted by his visitors as saying he will do his best to see that local elections are held.
-Work started on building a museum and monument to victims of Israel's April 1996 blitz on Lebanon.
-Chief of Hizbollah Sheikh Nasrallah said :"We will start the total elimination process of South Lebanon Army".
-Prime Minister Hariri will meet French President Chirac in Paris on Tuesday.
